# CANDIDATE: UNUSUAL_WHALES_CALL_SWEEP_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large, abnormal SPY call sweeps reported by the Unusual Whales feed often precede short‑term upward price moves, providing a leading intraday long signal. The signal captures aggressive institutional buying pressure that shows up in the options tape before it fully manifests in the underlying, allowing the engine to get long early in the move.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the Unusual Whales feed logs a call sweep with premium > $500,000 and traded volume > 2× the average open interest for that strike within the last 5 minutes, and the subsequent bar closes above VWAP with a bullish ribbon (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55), go long at the open of the next bar.  
Exit: Stop placed at the most recent swing low (or 0.5% of entry price, whichever is larger); TP1 at 2× risk; runner trailed using a premium‑stop of 20% of the option premium associated with the sweep. Regime filter: only active when VIX is between 12 and 25 and time is 09:30–11:30 EST; avoid first 15 minutes after open.
